title: Moltres Heals by Diving Into a Volcano
premise: Moltres is said to heal injuries by dipping its body into a volcano's molten magma.
audiencePromise: Reveal the brutal healing method hidden in Moltres's Pokédex entry.
openLoop: Why would a fire-controlling bird use molten magma to heal?
payoff: The same fire Moltres controls becomes the answer when injury strikes.
engagementQuestion: Would you trust magma healing, or call it too dangerous?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and amazed. Stress magma, injury, and heal. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: THE CURE IS MAGMA
scenes.narration: Moltres may heal injuries by burning in magma.
scenes.caption: HEALING THROUGH MAGMA

scenes.headline: INJURY COMES FIRST
scenes.narration: The entry's sequence is simple: injured first, then dipped into molten magma.
scenes.caption: INJURY → MOLTEN MAGMA

scenes.headline: FIRE CONTROL GOES FURTHER
scenes.narration: Moltres controls fire, while its injuries lead it toward molten magma.
scenes.caption: FIRE CONTROL MEETS MAGMA

scenes.headline: DIP. BURN. HEAL.
scenes.narration: When injured, it dips its body into magma to burn and heal itself.
scenes.caption: DIP → BURN → HEAL

scenes.headline: FIRE BECOMES THE ANSWER
scenes.narration: The same fire Moltres controls becomes the answer when injury strikes.
scenes.caption: FIRE ANSWERS INJURY

scenes.headline: TRUST THE MAGMA?
scenes.narration: Would you trust magma healing, or call it too dangerous?
scenes.caption: TRUST IT OR FEAR IT?
